how_it_was_chosen: NOT by the selection rule. The rule (MODEL_SELECTION.md section 6) selected the one-class SVM, locked in configs/locked_model_v3.json, by a 0.08 s median-delay tie-break. LightGBM was adopted afterwards because, on the pre-registered fresh test set sim_test3, the boosted models were better on detection, false alarms, consistent takeover and 90th-percentile delay; the choice was then confirmed for LightGBM alone on a second fresh set sim_test4 (configs/preregistered_test4.json).

evidence.unbiased_estimate: sim_test4 (not used to choose the model): detection 0.991 (0.984-0.995), 0.37 FA/h (0.25-0.53), median/p90 delay 1.48/4.1 s, consistent takeover 0.94; weak 0-1 dB (sim_weak4) detection 0.948, consistent takeover 0.65
evidence.rule_selected_model_for_comparison: one-class SVM on sim_test2: detection 0.970, 0.58 FA/h, consistent takeover 0.807

known_costs: median delay about 0.5 s longer than the one-class SVM (1.4-1.5 s vs 1.0 s); weak consistent takeover still 0.65
reversible: this file does not change locked_model_v3.json; the rule-selected result remains reported in full
